Lightning Lore +21: Passive: Your Electricity spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Insightful Evocation Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Evocation spells.
Wizardry +269: +269 Enhancement bonus to spell points.
Elemental Resonance +142: Passive: +142 Equipment bonus to Acid, Fire, Electric and Cold Spell Power.
Acid Lore +21: Passive: Your Acid spells gain a 21% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Insightful Conjuration Focus +3: +3 Insight bonus to the DC of Conjuration spells.
